sample_unit: raters (22 expert physicians and 24 NEN patients) scoring responses to 9 questions

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy, clarity and completeness of LLM answers to neuroendocrine neoplasm management questions
links.effect: Mean scores: ChatGPT Plus 3.72, Copilot 3.54, Perplexity 3.22, with clarity rated highest; the chemotherapy indications question scored lowest.
links.quote: The chemotherapy indications question received the lowest scores, underscoring LLM challenges in handling complex clinical decisions.

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLM responses to neuroendocrine neoplasm management questions rated by both clinicians and patients, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparison.
